name: Ferienwohnung Kaiserblick
beschreibung:
Peacefully and sunnily situated in the cultural village of Erl, Ferienwohnung Kaiserblick welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth. The generous and comfortably furnished apartment features a balcony facing the dramatic Kaiser peaks.

The renowned Tyrol Festival Erl, mountain paths toward the Blaubergalm, and riverside cycling trails along the Inn are minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kaiserblick in Erl provides splendid views of the Kaiser mountains in the picturesque festival village.
